issues.issue: Did the Member err by ignoring the applicants' upcoming refugee hearings when assessing flight risk and alternatives to detention?
issues.applicant_position: Member had to consider likelihood of appearing at refugee hearings, as Justice Phelan directed; ignoring that was fatal.
issues.respondent_position: Not stated on this point; respondent says the decision need only show justification, transparency and intelligibility.
issues.result_quote: I find that her failure to consider the RPD proceeding, jointly in assessing flight risk and in assessing alternatives to detention

issues.issue: Did the applicants concede flight risk at the hearing, so that they cannot raise it on review?
issues.applicant_position: No real concession was made; the Member said she would conduct a full flight-risk analysis, so they could rely on it.
issues.respondent_position: Applicants conceded flight risk at the detention review hearing and are precluded from raising it on judicial review.
issues.result_quote: Concession or not, the Member explicitly said she was going to consider a full flight risk analysis and the applicants had a reasonable expectation that she would do so.

issues.issue: Should the Court decide the application although it may be moot once the next detention review occurs?
issues.respondent_position: Application will be moot unless decided by May 12, 2015, given the next scheduled detention review.
issues.result_quote: In the case at bar, the Court should exercise its discretion notwithstanding mootness.

issues.issue: Should the Court follow Justice Phelan's earlier decision on the same flight-risk issue (judicial comity)?
issues.applicant_position: Court should grant the application relying on Justice Phelan's reasons, since no new evidence was heard on re-determination.
issues.respondent_position: Fresh judicial review; the Court should only assess justification, transparency and intelligibility of the new decision.
issues.result_quote: I see no reasons to depart from Justice Phelan’s reasons with respect to that first issue.

issues.issue: Did the Member err in assessing the release plan as an alternative to detention?
issues.applicant_position: The Member did not properly assess the proposed release plan as an alternative to detention.
issues.result_quote: I do not find it necessary to consider whether the Member committed a reviewable error in her assessment of the release plan.
